profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Engine
profile.summary: Software engineer with over 15+ years of experience building products and distributed systems using Java, Node.js/TypeScript and React across many different domains such as billing, developer productivity, growth, identity, developer platforms and agentic AI integrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Node.js · Distributed Systems · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · TypeScript · Redis · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloudflare · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · React.js

positions.title: Java/J2EE Analyst Programmer / Operations Analyst
positions.description:
- Fulfilled an operations support capacity with a service management focus on incidents, problems and mission critical production system (bespoke and third party) changes - ITIL. Mainly serviced the Corporate and Asset Finance (CAF) business group and its individual businesses, in particular Macquarie Leasing Pty Ltd.

- Applications development / enhancements experience (SDLC end to end) in a variety of programming languages and platforms - Java / J2EE, VB.Net, Unix (Solaris), Sybase, SQL, Unidata and InfoLease. 

- Managed and implemented of a number of infrastructure upgrades for mission critical production systems as well as data migration / integration for large acquisition projects. 

- Technical lead for the migration and remediation of legacy applications onto the Windows 7 platform.

positions.title: Analyst (Intern)
positions.description:
- Serviced support requests for VAX/VMS Alpha systems.
- Documented business processes.
- Generated reporting packs covering client service delivery metrics in the Asia Pacific region.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Implemented configuration data from business use cases for court case / proceeding workflow and dynamic generation of documents on the NSW Courtlink case management system. (2nd phase)

positions.title: Production Support Developer/Systems Analyst (Intern)
positions.description: J2EE production support developer for the NSW Courtlink system.
